title: Organization command permissions
summary: Owners and maintainers choose on the site which commands agents can never run in the organization's projects, for the whole organization or per repository.
usage: On the site, open the organization's Permissions tab, pick the scope (the organization or one repository), check the programs or subcommands to block, add other commands one per line, and save. A repository can only block more. In a chat, Permissions lets you allow specific commands; blocked ones show as disabled. Agents without a per-command list run in their safest mode in these projects. Changes arrive at the next sync.
